meta.title: Halo Infinite Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert FPS sensitivity to Halo Infinite. Accurate cm/360 calculation.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_halo-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your Halo Infinite mouse sensitivity. Found in Settings → Mouse → Mouse Sensitivity. Include zoom level sensitivities for scoped weapons.
steps_halo-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the game to convert to. Halo's longer time-to-kill rewards tracking aim — the converted sensitivity should prioritize smooth tracking over flick speed.
steps_halo-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted sensitivity. Practice tracking aim in the Academy or bot matches before jumping into ranked arena.
